material.title: Independent evaluation: Acme-2 scores 61% on SWE-bench Verified, below the 72% the lab reported
material.bodyOriginal: We ran Acme-2 on SWE-bench Verified in our standard harness (mini-swe-agent, high reasoning effort, pass@1, 3 runs, ±1.8%). It resolved 61.0% of tasks, compared with the 72% Acme reported at launch using its internal scaffold. Per-task results and logs are public.
